name: epub-reader
tagline: Read EPUB books on your Even G2 glasses
description:
Read EPUB books directly on your Even Realities G2 smart glasses. Upload books from your phone or browse the Project Gutenberg Top 100 catalog, then read hands-free on the glasses.

Features:
- Local library: books cached on-device for offline reading (searchable companion UI)
- Two reading modes: Paged (swipe to turn pages) and Flow (word-by-word speed reading, 120-600 WPM)
- Native contextual menu on glasses: Contents, mode switch, bookmarks, flow speed
- Interruption recovery: sentence rewind during Flow, auto-rewind on resume, chapter time-left
- Flicker-free page turns and configurable text brightness
- Automatic hyphenation in 9 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian
- Configurable status bar with clock and reading progress
- Automatic position saving across app restarts
- Project Gutenberg integration

Controls:
- Swipe down/up: Next/previous page, or sentence navigation in running Flow
- Tap: Hide/show reading info in paged mode; play/pause in Flow
- Double tap: Back one level
- Hold: Contextual menu (Contents, mode, bookmark, speed)
author: Andriy <evendev@proton.me>
